monsterSpawnSchema.coordinates: World XY at monster feet, same units/origin as project.spawn; not cells or screen pixels
monsterSpawnSchema.respawnSeconds: Seconds after death; 0 means no respawn
monsterSpawnSchema.registry: Game must map monsterId to its own template/assets/AI. Never infer type from spawn point ID or image filename.
monsterSpawnSchema.runtime: MonsterSpawnController: poll(dt) -> requests; confirm(instanceId) on creation, reject on failure, markDead on death. Use one authoritative controller per map instance on server; offline can run locally.

interactionSchema.identity: mapId + object.id; IDs belong to this map, not separate object packs
interactionSchema.actionId: Shared handler ID; many objects may use mine_spirit_stone
interactionSchema.range: World units from player feet to object-local interaction.point after scale/rotation/flip
interactionSchema.reward: resourceId + inclusive integer min/max; spirit_stone is Linh thạch
interactionSchema.respawnSeconds: Seconds after successful collection; 0 means no respawn
interactionSchema.runtime: interactionDefinitions, nearestInteraction. InteractionSimulator is PREVIEW ONLY: not an authoritative currency or multiplayer system. Game server must validate channeling and atomically credit wallet once + deplete the node.

usage: Use map-runtime.mjs version 4 for objects[].interaction; interactionDefinitions/nearestInteraction read mapId + objectId; INTERACTIONS-CODEX.md explains authoritative mining/wallet integration. InteractionSimulator is preview only. Version 3 supports monsterSpawns. Version 5 supports original house/tall/post/fence/seat/fire props; use the bundled runtime for these kinds. map.getMonsterSpawns() reads IDs; MonsterSpawnController manages spawn/respawn requests with game monster registry. See MONSTER-SPAWNS.md. Version 2 supports curved roads. DarkinMapPlayer.load(bundle); update(dt,dx,dy); draw(ctx,width,height). update returns a warp descriptor; your game must resolve its target map. draw(...,{drawActor(ctx,actor){...}}) integrates your CutoutPlayer. Roads are visual terrain and do not override water/collisions. No combat, NPC AI, server or Tiled importer is included.
